effect_description_eng: ＜Iceclad＞ (Other than against Security Digimon, compare the number of digivolution cards instead of DP in this Digimon's battles.) [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash any 3 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends. (Rule) Trait: Has [Ice-Snow] Type.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If this effect didn't trash, this [Ice-Snow] trait Digimon may unsuspend.
